name: yt-transcript-summary-extractor
description: YouTube Transcript & Summary Extractor: Next.js frontend and Express API. No database, no AI APIs.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
